subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
8.
Whether the dividend should be recognized as a liability in the financial
statements of Fresh Farm Foods Ltd., as at 31st March 2025?
(A)  Yes, it must be recognized in the same year irrespective of the date of
declaration.
(B)  No, the amount should be recognized equally between the two financial
years.
(C)  No, the dividend should not be recognized as a liability, instead the
amount of proposed dividend should be appropriately disclosed.
(D)  No, it should neither be recognized nor disclosed.
(2 Marks)
